stages.agents: Data Agent maps the DMS columns, loads BigQuery and back-fills 90 days of sell-through by pincode and by shop.
stages.money: The true cost of a write-off is shown before any batch is routed: stock at cost + ITC reversal + disposal + EPR, −₹19.36 a packet of chips.
stages.sees: Priya signs in to Munchly's workspace, connects the distributor stock export and sets the allow-list, the floors, the donation partners, the territory guard and the return window. Rakesh bhai signs in with his phone and lets the agent act in his name.
stages.title: Connect
stages.who: Priya sets the guardrails; Rakesh bhai gives a one-time permission

stages.agents: Watcher checks each quick-commerce gate, projects sell-through to seven days before best-before, raises batch.at_risk.
stages.money: ₹40,800 at MRP at risk; destroying it would hit Munchly's P&L by −₹26,330, the ITC reversal included.
stages.pain: We find out when it has already expired
stages.sees: A push and a dashboard alert: MF-2409-117 Masala Chips is blocked from quick commerce and 1,360 units will not sell by 18 Nov.
stages.title: Detect

stages.agents: Vision Agent (Gemini) reads batch, MFG, best-before and MRP from the photo and reconciles them with the DMS record.
stages.money: MRP ₹30 confirmed from the pack: every price anchors to a verified number.
stages.pain: DMS data is wrong half the time
stages.sees: Rakesh bhai gets a Hindi push, taps it, the camera opens, one picture of the carton label.
stages.title: Verify

stages.agents: Valuer prices five channels against days left, capacities and the floor, with the GST-aware write-off as the baseline.
stages.money: Net ₹ per unit for every channel, and whether the input credit survives: −₹19.36 a unit if destroyed.
stages.pain: We just dump it to whoever answers
stages.sees: A channel table: price, days to clear and net ₹ per channel, ineligible channels greyed with the reason.
stages.title: Value

stages.agents: Router fills the best-paying channel to its capacity, then the next, and writes why.
stages.money: ₹21,770 net, 53% of MRP. Munchly's P&L +₹10 against −₹26,330 if destroyed: a ₹26,340 swing.
stages.sees: A recommended split with plain-language reasoning and one alternative side by side.
stages.title: Decide

stages.agents: Agents wait. The approval is logged with who, when and which channels.
stages.money: The sheet repeats the three numbers that matter: net ₹21,770, swing ₹26,340, ITC ₹1,224 retained.
stages.pain: I don't trust a bot to sell my brand
stages.relief: Nothing goes out without a tap
stages.sees: Priya taps Approve from the push or the dashboard. Nothing is listed, messaged or shipped before this, and Rakesh bhai gets the same plan with a pause button.
stages.title: Approve

stages.agents: Lister posts to ExpireSoon in Rakesh Traders' name, hidden from buyers inside Munchly's territories; Outreach pushes a Hindi offer to 38 kiranas; Negotiator handles the bid; Donation books Feeding India for the Mango Drink batch.
stages.money: Planned against actual as the bid lands: ₹15 → ₹14.20 a unit on the ExpireSoon lot, ₹21,770 → ₹21,152 net.
stages.relief: Live in minutes, the agent chases
stages.sees: The agent timeline: listing live, kirana orders ticking up, a bid countered, the award.
stages.title: Execute
stages.who: Kiranas and a buyer in Raipur respond

stages.agents: Paperwork drafts Rakesh's invoice, checks the e-way bill threshold, issues the price-support credit note, writes the ITC memo and the FSSAI checklist.
stages.money: No ITC reversal under s.17(5)(h); no e-way bill under ₹50,000. Price support to Rakesh: ₹8,768, the ₹394 van and listing fee included, instead of a ₹34,490 expiry claim.
stages.pain: Finance finds out at month end
stages.sees: The document pack: Rakesh's invoice drafted for him to issue, the e-way bill check, Munchly's price-support credit note and the ITC memo.
stages.title: Settle
stages.who: Rakesh bhai issues his invoice and dispatches; Priya reviews Munchly's papers

stages.agents: Impact Agent posts the ledger once the return window closes and builds the BRSR Principle 6 rows with evidence links.
stages.money: 217.6 kg diverted · 544 kg CO₂e avoided (indicative) · 0 meals: one line in the BRSR report.
stages.sees: The ledger, by quarter and year; one click exports the BRSR waste table and the GST summary.
stages.title: Report

workspace.name: Munchly Foods
workspace.outside: The ExpireSoon buyer signs in to the workspace's marketplace area with the address Munchly invited, and sees only the listings open to him. Buyers inside Munchly's territories never see them.

profile.text: Munchly sells only to its distributors. Each one supplies the kiranas on his salesman's beat and the Blinkit, Zepto and Instamart warehouses in his city.
profile.title: Route to market

profile.text: He bought it at ₹22.00 a pack, so the agent lists, offers and invoices in his name, with his one-time permission.
profile.title: Who owns short-dated stock

profile.text: Packs left at a distributor's godown on expiry day are destroyed there by an authorised agency. Munchly approves the evidence and credits him the dealer price, the input GST he reverses and the agency's charges, so Munchly acts before expiry and pays price support instead of a claim.
profile.title: Expiry policy

profile.text: A batch that misses a gate stays in the distributor's godown.
profile.title: Quick-commerce gates
profile.value: Blinkit 90+ days · Zepto, Instamart 60% of life

profile.text: ExpireSoon, the kirana scheme, a staff sale at the godown and food banks. Discount D2C and the Pune plant staff sale apply only to Munchly's own warehouse stock.
profile.title: Exits for distributor stock
profile.value: four, and the bin as the baseline

profile.text: ExpireSoon listings are hidden from buyers inside Munchly's distributor territories, matched by pincode.
profile.title: Territory guard

profile.text: Returned packs reach the godown in time for a staff sale or a food bank.
profile.title: Scheme returns
